gpu: Radeon Pro V620 (gfx1030), HIP 4 on par1-cs25 (PCI bus 0xdf, 175 W package cap); tuned once, the new rows are written identically to rank files 0-3
storage_policy: Opt-in derived profile (auto: false in tunableop/profiles.json): the canonical rocm7.14-rocblas5.5 rank files 0-3 byte-for-byte plus the rows below, so that no other recipe's lookup table changes. Selected by TUNABLEOP_PREFER=rocm7.14-rocblas5.5-hi2-27b-tp2 in tools/rdna/recipes/27b-hi2-tp2.env only; TUNABLEOP_PREFER= (empty) loads the canonical rows. Same rocBLAS build and lib_sha256 as the canonical profile. Never store rows in /tmp or the run CWD.
rank_policy: Ranks 0-3 hold the canonical rows plus identical new rows (TP=2 workers read ranks 0 and 1; one tuning on one V620 serves both ranks, same arch and build).

rank_agreement.rule: rank files 0-3 name the same solution for every key; the canonical rows were agreed first and carried over byte for byte

campaign.tools: tools/rdna/rdna_hint_flex/tunableop_hi2.sh (phases shapes, record, tune, gather, measure, check, curate, time, hit, emul), tunable_hi2.py, sched_census.py, tunable_report.py, tp2_emul_check.py
campaign.gpu_state: HIP 4 (V620, bus 0xdf) while the alternating measurement passes ran, 2 s rocm-smi samples at >= 150 W: junction 76-81 C, package 169-176 W against a 175 W cap, sclk 1230-1955 MHz (median 1595)
campaign.tuning: tune_missing_gemms.sh tune: PYTORCH_TUNABLEOP_ENABLED=1 TUNING=1 HIPBLASLT_ENABLED=0 TORCH_BLAS_PREFER_HIPBLASLT=0, TunableOp defaults (max 30 ms and 100 iterations per candidate, 4 MiB rotating buffer), numerical check atol=rtol=2e-3 (tune_missing_gemms.sh TUNE_ATOL/TUNE_RTOL), prefill group in 4 shards, sched groups of 25 keys in 5 shards of 5, one flock hold per shard

groups.prefill: 7 slots x M 1024, 2048 = 14 keys (10 adopted: gate_up, qkvz, qkv, out/o, ba; down and fc dropped)
groups.sched2: 5 slots x M 1033, 1036, 1039, 1042, 1045 = 25 keys (MTP=2 mixed steps)

campaign.curation: cold-weight CUDA-graph timing, adopt when the tuned time is under 97 % of the heuristic's; stage one on the median of the first pass and three alternating heuristic/tuned passes for the 34 keys near the margin (a first-pass-only curation adopts 25 rows instead of 31), stage two (sched2, 25 keys) on one pass; down and the MTP fc were tuned only at M 1024 and 2048 (no gain) and are timed twice, untuned, at the other scheduler M (noise floor -1.4..+0.5 %)
campaign.numerics: rowcheck.py on 89 candidate rows (gaussian and outlier-channel inputs, eager and HIP graph, vs fp64): 0 rejected, worst error ratio 1.00, max |err|/max|ref| 2.1e-4..4.8e-4, relative L2 2.05e-4..2.09e-4, tuned bits equal the default's for 32 and differ for 57
campaign.lookup: tunableop_hi2.sh hit: 36 of 36 new keys found in this folder's rank 0 file (rows=3366, missing=0)
campaign.model_level: tp2_emul_check.py (real checkpoint at TP=1, the TP=2 per-rank GEMMs issued in place of each full-width one), 3 prompts x 64 greedy tokens, rows off vs on: tokens identical in both runs; batched (3361-row profile) max |dlogit| over the top-20 raw fp16 logits 0.094, one at a time (this folder) 0.043; doc section 4.2
campaign.open_gate: deterministic concurrency probe on HIP 2,3 (flat all-reduce) not run
